about_the_game:
The night was a special night for a set of young thrill-seekers as they were getting initiated into the Wardens and were going in to acquire their first Mythokyn to get their journey started. However, chaos brewed upon the horizon, and as they descended into the forest to acquire their first partner for their journey ahead, a stream of comets rained from the sky. Chaos erupted across the environments around them, stirring all of the untamed Mythokyn into a fury. Now their initiation night had turned into a fight for survival as they must make their way back to the safety of Gladehaven one way or another.

In this game, you'll be utilizing a wide variety of creatures, known as Mythokyn, to fight your way through hordes of untamed Mythokyn as you trek your way back to safety.

Start your adventure out with a choice between a handful of Mythokyn Summoners and 3 different Mythokyn out of a wide variety of Mythokyn.

Fight through rooms featuring enraged Mythokyn, and some surprises, and acquire various items, power-ups, or newfound abilities to help enhance your runs.

Acquire all capture crystals that you can use to capture other enemy Mythokyn on your journey, by focusing onto them and capturing their essence with crystal in hand to further expand your team of Mythokyn that you can command/play as.

Acquire new Techniques to teach your Mythokyn team to expand your arsenal or discover power-ups to increase your team's overall stats to better prepare you for the treacherous wilds that await you on your journey back to Gladehaven.

Build up the best team combinations you can as the chaos of the night attempts to overwhelm you on your way back to Gladehaven with a wide variety of options to help get you back there in every single run in this action roguelike adventure!
